## Import



BDRC disaster recovery site pair can be imported using the sitePairId#sitePairProductType, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Bdrc/disasterRecoverySitePair:DisasterRecoverySitePair example sitepair-la2re1mv#INSTANCE
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
